global_style: An editorial, fashion-forward presentation template featuring deep Morandi colors, stark geometric blocking, and striking rotated typography.

identity_anchors: Sideways/rotated oversized header text on slide edges
Thick, solid color-blocking creating robust geometric backgrounds
Asymmetrical overlapping of full-bleed and heavily inset photographs
Minimalist palette dot clusters used as decorative motifs
Strict right-angle geometry with small square accents in corners

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
